import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(
    x='Sleep Duration', 
    y='Stress Level', 
    hue='BMI Category', 
    size='Physical Activity Level', 
    data=df, 
    alpha=0.7, 
    palette='viridis'
)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.ylabel('Perceived Stress Level')
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Stress Level by BMI Category (Size: Activity Level)')
plt.legend(title='BMI Category', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
